summary: OpenAI published a report describing two clusters of China-linked ChatGPT accounts it banned for running covert influence operations targeting US AI and tariff policy debates.

practices.reason: Describes OpenAI's internal detection and disruption process for covert influence campaigns, useful context on threat monitoring but not a transferable method.
practices.quote: we describe two clusters of ChatGPT accounts likely originating from China that we banned after they used our models in support of apparent covert influence operations
